name: places-10m
description: Cities shown on the dashboard when it is zoomed in. Source: Natural Earth 1:10m populated places (public domain), filtered to the dashboard's view. Turkish names are ours (tools/geo/place_names_tr.csv); `n` is Natural Earth's name, `tr` the Turkish one where we have it, `a` the ISO alpha-3 of the state Natural Earth assigns it to, `p` population, `r` scale rank, `cap` a national capital.
